mainEntity.name: How do I stop an AI assistant from publishing or spending money by mistake?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Set approval checkpoints before any action that publishes, sends, spends, changes an account, or affects a customer. AI can prepare the draft or recommended action, while the owner retains the final decision.

Context: Run My AI Biz explicitly emphasizes approval before messages, publication, spending, and service sign-ups. Its workflows also call for secure account connections and source verification.

Key factors:
- Action severity
- Account permissions
- Reversibility
- Availability of an audit trail

Practical guidance: Use separate draft and live environments where possible, restrict permissions to the minimum needed, and keep a record of who approved each consequential action. Test with dummy data before granting live access.

Run My AI Biz teaches human-directed automation rather than unattended control.
acceptedAnswer.description: Keep publishing, messaging, purchasing, sign-ups, and account changes behind explicit approval. Limit permissions, test with dummy data, separate draft from live work where possible, and keep an approval record for consequential actions.
